# ConvoShelf

> ConvoShelf is a Chrome extension by Toolshed that adds folders, tags, full-text search and export to your ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok chats, with your data kept in your browser. You can import a ChatGPT data export and search those chats on your computer.

Current version: 1.4.1, on the Chrome Web Store as of November 28, 2026; Firefox Add-ons also offers 1.4.1, and Edge is still 1.2.0 until that store's review finishes. New in 1.4.1: Highlights, on the Clips tab, collects the passages you highlighted, your bookmark notes and your key takeaways from every chat in one list. Search it, jump back to the message, or export it all as Markdown (free). On the free plan, takeaways and bookmarks share the 15-item limit; Pro is unlimited. The free plan has no time limit: unlimited top-level folders, tags and pins, full-text search of opened or indexed chats (no chat-count cap) plus imported ChatGPT and Claude exports (up to 20,000 chats; a very long imported chat keeps its most recent 400,000 characters), export of the open chat to Markdown or PDF, archive on ChatGPT and confirmed deletion of up to 10 chats per run on supported sites, 10 saved prompts (a chain counts as one), 10 clips, 15 bookmarks, two auto-file rules, 1 handoff a day, a command palette, prompt blanks, a chat outline, a // prompt picker and a searchable Highlights list of highlighted passages, bookmark notes and key takeaways with Markdown export. Pro is US$4.99 once, with no subscription, and adds subfolders up to 3 levels, bulk and JSON export (including a ZIP of a folder or selection), deletion of more than 10 chats per run, optional browser sync of folder structure and saved prompts, search filters, bulk move, tag and pin, folder colors, unlimited prompts, clips, bookmarks and auto-file rules, clip export, one-click handoff, jump-to-message from a search result, an outline navigation rail, and selected-message export with redaction. Bookmarks travel in local backups and stay out of browser sync. The panel, popup and Options are translated into English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese and Brazilian Portuguese.

There is no ConvoShelf account or chat-storage server. Folders, tags and saved chat text stay in the browser. ConvoShelf's own network requests are the Pro license check, which sends the license key to Polar, and, only after you have seen its notice, an optional check of https://convoshelf.com/fixes/v1.json, a settings-only file fetched with no cookies, identifiers or chat data, which you can turn off in Options. Indexing and site actions talk only to the AI site you are signed in to. Optional Pro browser sync goes through your browser vendor and never includes chat text or clip bodies. Search depends on chats opened or indexed in this browser, plus any ChatGPT or Claude export you import. Official exports from Gemini or Grok cannot be imported. ConvoShelf is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or xAI.
